neighbours.label: inner pieces of Latin botanical/biochemical names (col|ch|icum, F|uc|us, gl|au|ca)
fire: The gardener planted colchicum bulbs along the north wall.
Extracts of Fucus vesiculosus are sold as a dietary supplement.
Colchicine is still used to treat attacks of gout.
The herbalist recommended a tea made from Galphimia glauca.
Brown algae of the family Fucaceae grow on rocky shores.
Tremella fuciformis is an edible jelly fungus.
Autumn-flowering colchicums bloom before their leaves appear.
The order Fucales includes many common seaweeds.
quiet: The gardener planted tulip bulbs along the north wall.
Extracts of green tea are sold as a dietary supplement.
Ibuprofen is still used to treat attacks of pain.
The herbalist recommended a tea made from fresh mint.
Brown algae of many kinds grow on rocky shores.
The white button mushroom is an edible fungus.
Autumn-flowering crocuses bloom before their leaves appear.
The order of the plants includes many common seaweeds.

notes: The pole has two kinds of top example: Python indentation opening a statement after a blank line (more frequent, probe 0.3-0.6) and pieces of Latin plant names (probe 0.7-0.97). This tests the second only, so coverage is likely partial.
